control_flow: followInTheDark: if LLIGHT < 70, then if the line tracker reads < 40 curve left, else if it reads > 88 curve right, else nothing; if LLIGHT is 70 or more, nothing.
avoidWalls, driveInTheDark, stopAtWall and followLine are defined but never called, so only followInTheDark runs.
